name: Swampert + Skarmory
why: Swampert shrugs off Electric and Fire; Skarmory resists Swampert's 4× Grass weakness.

name: Heatran + Celebi
why: Heatran resists most of Celebi's weaknesses; Celebi resists Water, Ground, Fighting.

name: Hippowdon + Starmie + Skarmory
why: Water, Ground, and Steel cover each other's holes, with Rocks, Spikes, and Rapid Spin.

name: Crobat + Quagsire + Heatran
why: Crobat checks Grass, Quagsire Water and Electric; Heatran sets Rocks and covers the rest.

name: Scizor + Tyranitar
why: Tyranitar resists Fire, Scizor's only weakness; Scizor resists its Bug, Grass, Steel.

name: Dragonite + Magnezone
why: Magnezone resists Ice, Rock, Dragon; Dragonite resists Fire and Fighting, ignores Ground.

name: Dragonite + Metagross
why: Metagross resists Ice, Rock, and Dragon; Dragonite resists Fire and ignores Ground.

name: Gyarados + Jolteon
why: Jolteon absorbs Electric, Gyarados's 4× weakness; Gyarados ignores Ground.

name: Kingdra + Scizor
why: Scizor resists Dragon, Kingdra's only weakness; Kingdra resists Scizor's Fire weakness.

name: Flygon + Scizor
why: Scizor resists Flygon's Ice and Dragon weaknesses; Flygon resists Fire, Scizor's weakness.

name: Infernape + Weavile
why: Infernape resists Weavile's Bug, Rock, Steel, Fire weaknesses; Weavile ignores Psychic.

name: Breloom + Tyranitar
why: Tyranitar resists Fire, Flying, Psychic, and Poison; Breloom resists Ground, Water, Grass.

name: Flygon + Magnezone
why: Magnezone resists Flygon's Ice and Dragon weaknesses; Flygon floats over Ground.

name: Zapdos + Breloom
why: Breloom resists Zapdos's Rock weakness, and Zapdos resists Breloom's 4× Flying.

name: Infernape + Tyranitar
why: Tyranitar resists Infernape's Flying and Psychic; Infernape resists its Grass, Steel, Bug.

name: Dragonite + Kingdra + Flygon
why: Kingdra draws in Steel and Ground walls so Dragonite sweeps and Flygon cleans up.
